description: Quote domain event payload schemas (common fields + per-event extras) in packages/event-schemas/src/schemas/domain/quoteEventSchemas.ts

QUOTE_SENT, QUOTE_VIEWED, QUOTE_APPROVED, QUOTE_ACCEPTED, QUOTE_REJECTED, QUOTE_EXPIRED, QUOTE_CONVERTED, QUOTE_CONVERSION_REVERTED, QUOTE_SUPERSEDED, QUOTE_CANCELLED registered in eventBusSchema EventType list and payload map
QUOTE_* entries in workflowEventCatalog.ts and workflowEventPayloadSchemas.ts (payload.Quote*.v1)
Citus-safe migration seeding the QUOTE_* rows in the workflow event catalog
Quote event payload builders in shared/workflow/streams/domainEventBuilders/quoteEventBuilders.ts, re-exported via the shared subpath
Correlation defaults map QUOTE_* to quoteId and clientId
Pure table-driven mapper quoteLifecycleEventFor(before, after, details) returning an event descriptor or null
queueQuoteLifecycleEvent emitter: registerAfterCommit + publishWorkflowEvent with actor ctx and per-transition idempotency key (quote activity id; quote_viewed once per quote)
Quote.update emits via mapper + emitter whenever status changes (covers UI actions, REST QuoteService, client portal accept/reject, generic update/cancel)
Quote.transitionStatus seam (actor, reason, details, system flag) used by billing-side direct status writers
Expire-on-read in models/quote.ts uses a conditional update and emits QUOTE_EXPIRED only when a row changed
expireQuotesHandler uses a conditional update and emits QUOTE_EXPIRED per actually-expired quote
Revision supersede path emits QUOTE_SUPERSEDED with supersededByQuoteId and nextVersion
quoteConversionService emits QUOTE_CONVERTED with conversionTargets and contractId/invoiceId/salesOrderId
System-only converted -> accepted transition through the seam (system flag + reason) in releaseQuoteConversionForDeletedInvoice, emitting QUOTE_CONVERSION_REVERTED with releasedInvoiceId
First client-portal view (viewed_at set) emits QUOTE_VIEWED once; later views do not
Accepted payload carries acceptedByName, acceptedOnBehalf and selected optional item ids; actor type CONTACT for portal, USER for MSP/REST
Rejected payload carries rejectionReason
Resend and reminder do not emit QUOTE_SENT again
crmWorkerDal.update (workflow crm.* quote actions) emits via the same mapper + emitter; LEVERAGE pattern marker on the duplicated update
Opportunity link flows that call onQuoteSent/onQuoteAccepted do not emit quote lifecycle events
Write-path ledger contract test for every quotes.status writer (emits, delegates, or listed silent with reason)
'quote' added to WebhookEntity and 10 quote.* entries in eventRegistry.ts with entityIdKeys [quote_id, client_id]
WEBHOOK_QUOTE_PAYLOAD_FIELDS allowlist and ALWAYS_INCLUDED_KEYS_BY_ENTITY.quote = [quote_id]
EntityPayloadSpec generalised with carriedFields (domain keys copied snake-cased); quote spec uses it
quoteWebhookSubscriber created via createEntityWebhookSubscriber and registered in ENTITY_WEBHOOK_SUBSCRIBERS
Admin webhook settings show quote events and a Quote payload-fields group; field labels in every msp/profile.json locale incl. xx/yy
OpenAPI specs and MCP/chat API registries regenerated with quote events
docs/api/api-rate-limiting-and-webhooks.md lists quote events, when they fire, sources, and retraction semantics for superseded/conversion_reverted
Worker DAL expire-on-read and combined conversion emit via the shared seam
Root connections and expiry job use owning transactions that flush after-commit hooks
Tenant-scoped deterministic event IDs and persistent webhook delivery receipts suppress concurrent and successful replay beyond Redis retention
